decisions.reason: As a niche agriculture-specific crate that was only ever mentioned rather than strongly featured, it is the most likely candidate for portfolio pruning if volumes stayed modest.
A foldable large container fits a large German plastics firm's core industrial logistics range and its dedicated product-page presence suggests continued strategic relevance.
A stackable plastic crate is a standard, reusable transport packaging product, so even with limited website prominence it likely remains commercially viable.
A medium-duty rackable pallet sits close to the firm's established pallet business and is likely retained unless it clearly overlaps with stronger existing models.
The spill-retention pallet serves a narrower compliance-oriented use case, but such specialized safety products often stay in range because they complement broader industrial handling lines.
A plastic pallet with load retainers is a practical line extension within materials-handling products and was initially given strong enough visibility to suggest ongoing demand.
